== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Karoshan]] Empire is a powerful interstellar entity and a primary member of the [[Karoshan Alliance]], which also includes the [[Visiri system]]. [[The Empire]] is currently embroiled in a civil war following the abdication of Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax the Second and the subsequent treason conviction of her daughter, [[Shyrax the Third]]. While Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax claims to be the rightful ruler of the planet [[Karosha]], the [[throne]] is currently held by her cousin, King Regent{{!}}King Regent Felrex. The political landscape is further complicated by the presence of a faction known as The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected, and [[Felrex]]'s ambition to lead the [[Iron Legion]] in an invasion of the [[Galactic Union]]. Physically, Karoshan{{!}}Karoshans are a massive species, typically standing between nine and eleven feet tall, making them significantly larger than humans. They possess thick skin, varying shades of bronze or yellow pigmentation, and distinctive hair that grows in thick, glowing strands resembling neon or cables. Due to their restrained nature and physical appearance, they often appear stoic or difficult for other species to read. [[The Empire]] maintains a formidable military presence characterized by blocky, black spacecraft, ranging from standard cruisers equipped with starfighters to massive, six-mile-long dreadnoughts. Their fleet is capable of significant devastation and has been known to conduct blockades and large-[[scale]] deployments. The [[Karoshan]] military is regarded with fear by many, including soldiers of the [[Galactic Union]], who view them as legendary hunters.}}
